type: Lockstitch sewing machine electronic control box (Qixing/琦星 brand — NOT Jack)

specs.display: LCD with 7-segment display (BBB:BB:BB format), character map for numbers and alphabet, icons: free sewing, multi-segment sewing, bar-tacking, needle up/down, trimming, presser foot, clamp, loud speaker, wireless signal
specs.interface: Start/End Back-Tacking keys (AB / CD panel), Free Sewing+Trim key, Needle stop up/down, Clamp function key, P (parameter enter/save/exit), + (increase), - (decrease), < (left select), > (right select), Restore Factory (needle-hole touch switch)
specs.parameterEntryUser: Long press P key to enter User Parameter Mode (P01-P43, P99, P108, PA0, PA3)
specs.parameterEntryTechnician: Hold P key and turn on power — shows P27 — to enter Technician Parameter Mode (P44-P99, P108, PA0, PA3)
specs.factoryResetMethod: Use a machine needle to press the Restore Factory hole touch switch
specs.speedAdjust: Press + to accelerate, press - to decelerate; each press adjusts by 50 r/S
specs.warranty: 1 year from purchase, or 2 years from ex-factory date

note: A3 is manufactured by Qixing (琦星), NOT Jack. Parameter naming conventions differ significantly from Jack machines. Needle position default is DN (down) — opposite labeling from some Jack machines where UP means stops-up. Error codes use E-prefix with 2-digit number (E01, E03, E07...) — not the Err-XX or E1/E2 format used in Jack machines.

errorCodes.cause: Power ON voltage detection too high, or supply voltage is too high
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power supply and detect whether the supply voltage is correct (or exceeds rated voltage). If correct, please replace the control box and inform the factory.

errorCodes.cause: Power ON voltage detection too high, or supply voltage is too high (same display category as E01)
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power supply and detect whether the supply voltage is correct (or exceeds rated voltage). If correct, please replace the control box and inform the factory.

errorCodes.cause: Operation panel and CPU transmission communication exception
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power. Check the operation panel interface is loose. If contact is good, please change the operation panel. If it is not operated, the control box is damaged, please change.

errorCodes.cause: Control of the contact of the device — connector loose or fallen off
errorCodes.solution: Off the system power supply. Check and control the connector is loose or fall off. Will resume normal after the restart system. If you still cannot work normally, please replace the speed controller and notify the manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Motor plug wiring not transferred, lock head or foreign body in card die, machine material too thick (motor torque insufficient), or module driven output exception
errorCodes.solution: Rotating head motor hand wheel to observe if stuck. If stuck, rule out mechanical failure first. Check the motor encoder connector and motor power cable joints are loose. If loose, revise. Check the supply voltage — if too high or too low, adjust to normal. If cannot adjust, please replace the control box and notify the manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Continuous manual back-stitch pour for over 15 seconds
errorCodes.solution: Back-sewing electromagnet time is too long; can restart.

errorCodes.cause: Electromagnetic overcurrent protection — solenoid connection line loose or solenoid valve damaged
errorCodes.solution: Power off system. Check solenoid (solenoid valve) connection line or solenoid (solenoid valve) is damaged. Check solenoid connection line or solenoid is damaged. Replace immediately if defective.

errorCodes.cause: Locating signal anomaly — motor encoder interface loose or disconnected
errorCodes.solution: Power off system. Check the motor encoder interface is loose or off. Will resume normal after the restart system. If you still cannot work normally, please inform the factory and replace the motor.
Turn off the system power. Check the power module and the heat sink is in good contact.

errorCodes.cause: Encoder signal exception — encoder interface loose or disconnected
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power. Check the motor encoder interface is loose or off. Will resume normal after the restart system. If you still cannot work normally, please replace the motor and notify the manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Power module not normal overcurrent protection
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power, and then restart. If you still cannot work normally, please inform the factory and replace the motor.

errorCodes.cause: Head protection switch is not in the correct position — machine head switch damaged
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power. Check the nose is opened, and the head switch is damaged.

errorCodes.cause: Power motor failed to start — motor encoder interface or motor power connector loose or fallen off
errorCodes.solution: Power off the system. Check the motor encoder interface and motor power connector is loose or fall off. It will resume normal after restarting the system. If it still does not work, replace the control box and inform the manufacturer.

monitoring.note: No dedicated monitoring table in A3 manual — use P42 Information Display (N01-N07) to view version, speed, pedal, angles, and busbar voltage

checks: Turn off system power
Check that the operation panel cable is firmly connected — not loose or fallen off
Reconnect the panel cable and restart
If contact is confirmed good but error persists, replace the operation panel
If still unresolved, the control box may be damaged — replace it
Rotate the hand wheel to check if the machine head is mechanically stuck
If stuck, identify and remove the mechanical obstruction before proceeding
Check the motor encoder connector and motor power cable — reconnect if loose
Check that supply voltage is within the rated range (up to 250V AC)
If voltage and connections are correct but error persists, replace the control box
Power off system immediately
Check all solenoid (electromagnet) connections — look for loose or damaged wires
Check if the solenoid valve itself is damaged
Replace any damaged solenoid or wiring immediately
Restart and check operation; inform manufacturer if problem recurs

troubleshooting.symptom: Machine will not start or pedal unresponsive on A3
checks: Check power connection and verify supply voltage is below 250V AC
Verify the motor plug and encoder connector are fully seated
Check P03 (needle position) setting — ensure it matches expected needle stop behavior
Check that the head protection switch (related to E17) is not activated
Verify P12 (start back-tacking mode) and P13 (end of start back-tacking) are set correctly
